rules.title: How to play
rules.intro: Give a clue about the word on your card. Listen to everyone else and look for the person who might have received something different.
rules.flow: Read your card in private. On your turn, give a short clue without saying the word itself. Play 1–3 clue rounds, then discuss before voting. Discussion can last 30, 60, or 120 seconds or run without a time limit. The timer can be paused. After one vote, the words, roles, and winners are revealed. Each winner earns two points. A Joker who wins alone earns three.
rules.vote: Each player has one secret vote and can vote for another player or an available group option. The option with the most votes wins if it has the sole lead. If there is a tie for first place or the wrong group option wins, nobody is voted out. In standard mixed modes, the imposter team wins when nobody is voted out. Special modes have their own win conditions.
rules.guess: With this rule enabled, an actual imposter who is voted out gets one guess within 20 seconds, before the reveal. The correct word or an accepted alias gives the imposter team the win. A wrong or missed guess leaves the civilians with the win. The rule is available in Classic, Random Imposters, Secret Alliance, Blind Imposter, and compatible Joker variants.
rules.abilities: Before voting, the Detective and Guardian can choose whom to investigate or protect, or pass. If the protected player has the sole vote lead, the elimination is blocked and nobody takes their place. After voting, resolve protection first, then a possible Joker win, then the mode's win conditions and last word guess. A round can have at most one extra role alongside an optional Joker. Extra roles require at least six players and the Joker requires at least five. The civilian team must outnumber the imposter team in mixed modes. A Joker variant also needs at least three civilians. Detective, Guardian, Accomplice, Double Agent, and Joker are available in Classic, Random Imposters, Blind Imposter, and Secret Alliance. Spy is available in Classic and Random Imposters.
rules.chaosPrivacy: A special mode chosen directly is visible to everyone. In Chaos, the selected profile stays hidden from everyone, including the host, until the round is over. Every player goes through a private step before voting. If the Chaos pool includes ‘Everyone is an imposter’ or ‘No one is an imposter’, both group options appear in every round.
rules.mode.classic: One imposter gets a hint and everyone else gets the same word. The civilians win if the imposter is voted out. Otherwise, the imposter team wins.
rules.mode.random: The number of imposters is randomly drawn from the chosen range and kept secret. Without extra roles, the maximum is (player count − 1) divided by 2 and rounded down. Extra roles can lower the maximum. Regular imposters share a hint and each other's identities remain secret. Voting out one actual imposter is enough for the civilians to win. Otherwise, the imposter team wins.
rules.mode.all: Everyone gets the same hint. The group wins if ‘Everyone is an imposter’ has the sole vote lead. Otherwise, nobody wins.
rules.mode.none: Everyone gets the same word. The group wins if ‘No one is an imposter’ has the sole vote lead. Otherwise, nobody wins.
rules.mode.reverse: One player gets the word and everyone else gets the same hint. The imposter team wins if the player with the word is voted out. That player wins in every other case, including a tie or an incorrect group vote.
rules.mode.joker: At least five players. One imposter gets the hint. The Joker gets the word and wins alone if voted out. Otherwise, Classic rules apply.
rules.mode.undercover: Everyone gets the same kind of word card. One player gets a different, related word. The majority wins if the player with the different word is voted out. Otherwise, that player wins. Both words appear at the reveal.
rules.mode.alliance: At least five players. Two imposters share a hint and know each other's identity. The civilians win if either of them is voted out. Otherwise, the imposter team wins.
rules.mode.blind: The imposter starts without a hint. The civilians get the word and win if the imposter is voted out. Otherwise, the imposter team wins.
rules.mode.chaos: The host chooses rule profiles and their relative weights. A higher weight makes a profile more likely to be selected. The pool contains only valid profiles. The drawn profile is revealed after voting and any last word guess.
rules.role.civil: You get the word and play for the civilian team.
rules.role.imposter: You play for the imposter team and usually get a hint. Voting you out counts as a hit for the civilians in standard mixed modes.
rules.role.joker: You get the word and win alone if you are voted out. If a Guardian protects you, the elimination is blocked.
rules.role.detective: You play for the civilians and get the word. Before voting, you can investigate one other player and learn whether they belong to the imposter team.
rules.role.guardian: You play for the civilians and get the word. Before voting, you can protect one other player from being voted out.
rules.role.spy: You get a related word and replace an imposter. Voting you out counts as an imposter hit.
rules.role.accomplice: You belong to the imposter team, share the imposter's hint when there is one, and know one actual imposter's identity. Civilians need to vote out an actual imposter to get a hit.
rules.role.double_agent: You belong to the imposter team and get the real word. The imposter's identity is secret from you. Civilians need to vote out an actual imposter to get a hit.
rules.role.undercover: In Undercover, you see only your word. The reveal shows which word the majority received.
settings.mode_description.classic: One imposter gets a hint. Everyone else gets the secret word.
settings.mode_description.random: The number of imposters is hidden. The civilians win by voting out any one imposter.
settings.mode_description.all: Everyone is an imposter and gets the same hint. The group wins by voting for Everyone is an imposter.
settings.mode_description.none: Everyone gets the same secret word. The group wins by voting for Nobody is an imposter.
settings.mode_description.reverse: Only one player gets the word. That player wins by surviving the vote.
settings.mode_description.joker: One imposter tries to blend in. The Joker wins alone if voted out.
settings.mode_description.undercover: One player gets a related word. Everyone gets the same type of card, and the majority tries to find the odd player out.
settings.mode_description.alliance: Two imposters know each other. The civilians win if either is voted out.
settings.mode_description.blind: One imposter plays without a hint. Everyone else gets the secret word.
settings.mode_description.chaos: Choose possible setups and their odds. The actual setup is revealed at the end of the round.
settings.subcategories_help: Select subcategories to narrow the word list. Leave them unchecked to include every subcategory in the selected categories.
settings.catalog_error: The categories could not load. Connect to the server or open the app with an offline pack ready.
settings.content_error: The words or rules could not load. Connect to the server or choose categories saved for offline play.
settings.extra_help: Extra roles require six players. A vote counts as hitting an imposter when the target is an actual imposter or the Spy. The Accomplice and Double Agent play for the imposter team.
settings.spy_modes: The Spy is available in Classic and Random Imposters.
settings.extra_disabled: This mode has a fixed lineup. Extra roles are available in Classic, Random Imposters, Secret Alliance, and Blind Imposter.
settings.joker_help: The Joker needs at least five players and at least three civilians after roles are dealt.
settings.joker_included: This mode already includes the Joker.
settings.joker_disabled: This mode has a fixed lineup. The Joker can be added in Classic, Random Imposters, Secret Alliance, and Blind Imposter.
settings.last_guess_help: An actual imposter who is voted out has 20 seconds to guess the word. A correct guess wins the round for the imposter team.
settings.last_guess_disabled: The final guess is available in modes where civilians can win by voting out an actual imposter.
settings.random_help: Leave the bounds blank for an automatic range. Enter the same value in both fields for a fixed number.
settings.chaos_modifiers: Choose the Joker, extra role, and final guess inside each Chaos profile.
settings.chaos_help: Weight controls the chance of drawing a profile. A weight of 2 is twice as likely as a weight of 1.
settings.issue.invalid_players: Check that every player has a name and their own place.
settings.issue.invalid_settings: Check the settings values. Select at least one familiarity level.
settings.issue.invalid_mode: Choose a valid game mode. Each Chaos profile needs a specific mode.
settings.issue.chaos_empty: Add at least one Chaos profile.
settings.issue.chaos_weight: Each Chaos profile needs a weight greater than zero.
settings.issue.joker_incompatible: Remove the Joker modifier or choose a compatible mode.
settings.issue.joker_players: The Joker requires at least five players.
settings.issue.extra_incompatible: This extra role is unavailable in this mode. Change the mode or pick a compatible role.
settings.issue.extra_players: The extra role requires at least six players.
settings.issue.invalid_distribution: The lineup needs more civilians than imposter team members and at least three civilians with the Joker. Add players or change the selected roles.
settings.issue.invalid_random_range: The imposter range must fit the group and selected roles. Leave both bounds blank for an automatic range.
settings.issue.last_guess_incompatible: Turn off the final word guess or choose a compatible mode.
settings.issue.no_words: This selection has no playable words. Add categories or broaden the subcategories and familiarity levels.
settings.issue.no_pairs: Undercover and Spy need a pair where both words match the filter. Add categories or familiarity levels, or clear subcategories.
